newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-METS TRADE BORLAND TO BOSTON FOR TRLICEK.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-METS TRADE BORLAND TO BOSTON FOR TRLICEK.

text.p: The New York Mets swapped middle relievers with the Red Sox on Monday, sending Toby Borland to Boston for another right-hander, Rick Trlicek.

The Mets designated the struggling Borland for assignment last Wednesday and were able to acquire Trlicek, a 28-year-old who was 4-3 with a 4.63 ERA in a team-high 18 appearances for the Red Sox this season.

Borland, 27, was 0-1 with a 6.08 ERA in 13 relief outings for the Mets, allowing 11 hits, nine runs and 14 walks in 13 1/3 innings. He was acquired from the Phillies along with Ricardo Jordan last November for first baseman Rico Brogna.
Trlicek returns to New York after pitching in 13 games for the Mets last season. He was 0-1 with a 6.08 ERA before being claimed off waivers by the Red Sox last October.
